shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: a buildable sky level above and a solid rock basement below, fully simulated as linked pocket maps with see-through open air and cross-level pawn AI.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level, you see the live surface below through open air; (2) performance via caching, incremental grids, and async pure-data work.

## Locked decisions (2026-07-18)
- Standalone C# + Harmony only (no Prepatcher, no MultiFloors dependency). Architecture lessons taken from MultiFloors (ws 3384660931) and Z-Levels Beta (ws 2127428910) decompiles.
- Cap: 3 levels per column (basement / surface / sky), enforced in LevelMapGen.
- Support rule: an upper-level floor cell is buildable only where the map below has a roof at that cell. Removing the roof below should collapse the unsupported floor above.
- Floor-above = roof-below: while an upper floor exists, the surface cell below carries a constructed-class roof (rain, sun, temperature correct below).
- Basement always generates as 100% solid rock matching surface geology (MapGeneratorDef.isUnderground auto-roofs everything with thick rock in 1.6).
- No bleed: open-air cells never render void or checker; map edges solid; basement is a normal enclosed map.
- Robustness: ABGuard per-subsystem kill switches (ui, levelGen, rendering, movement, logistics, roofSync); log once, shut down the subsystem, prefixes fail open. HarmonyBoot patches each class independently so one dead target cannot kill the mod.
- All player-facing text: vanilla sentence case, ASCII only, no long dashes.

## Architecture (as built so far)
- LevelComp (MapComponent on every map): level int (0 ground, +1 sky, -1 basement), upperMap / lowerMap / groundMap refs, and on the ground map the MapByLevel dictionary (column controller). All scribed with Scribe_References; invalid maps cleaned on load.
- LevelExtensions: cached accessors (ConditionalWeakTable) for Level() / UpperMap() / LowerMap() / GroundMap() / Controller().
- LevelMapGen: vanilla pocket map creation (PocketMapParent + MapGenerator.GenerateMap(isPocketMap: true) + Find.World.pocketMaps). A static generation Context lets the new map's LevelComp self-wire level + ground during generation. 1.6 seeds pocket maps from parent.ID, so per-level seeds are unique.
- LevelCamera.JumpPreservingView: switches the viewed map while keeping camera position + zoom (rememberedCameraPos + SetRootPosAndSize after the jump).
- ABGameComp: PageUp / PageDown level view hotkeys (KeyBindingDefs AB_ViewLevelUp / AB_ViewLevelDown, own category), kill switch reset on game load.
- Defs so far: KeyBindingCategoryDef AB_Keys, two KeyBindingDefs. Keyed strings for settings.

## Reference recipes adopted from decompiles
- Stairs: entrance building on current map generates the level map on first use, spawns a linked exit at the mirrored position on the new map (basement exits clear surrounding rock; sky exits lay standable terrain around themselves).
- See-below rendering: custom SectionLayer on the sky map that draws the surface map's content (both reference mods do this; gets vanilla dirty-tracking and mesh caching for free).
- Support rule precedent: MultiFloors PlaceWorker_LowerLevelRoofed.
- MapGeneratorDef.pocketMapProperties needs a biome for pocket maps.

## Tranche plan
- T0 (in progress): skeleton DONE (builds green). Remaining: basement + sky MapGeneratorDefs and GenSteps, stair buildings + JobDriver, first in-game test.
- T1: visuals: see-below SectionLayer, no-bleed, floor-to-roof sync.
- T2: movement: stair graph, cross-level pathing, drafted moves, pawns auto-use stairs for jobs.
- T3: logistics: hauling, storage, bills across levels.
- T4: systems: temperature, power across levels, threat policy, profiling and polish.

## Status
T0 skeleton compiled green (AsAboveSoBelow.dll, 0 warnings). Private repo As-above-So-below created per global workflow rules. Next: map generation defs + stairs.
